answer:
The beach in Florida that allows for alcohol consumption year-round, **except in the month of March**, is **Panama City Beach**.

Alcohol has been permitted on its beaches all year round since 2016 (with no spring break ban like other cities), with the sole exception of March when a complete ban is in effect to manage unruly crowds and prevent spikes in violence during the spring break season.
